title: Verified selection (tuning Phase 2 — user layer)
description: A closed-world, fully-labelled correction patch over one instrument LANE across a range of whole bars. Every note the user left in the region counts as ground truth alongside the ones they changed, giving the future param search both positive and negative labels. Persisted selections are always verified. The frozen `notes` are authoritative at compose time; `ops` are the change-history/replay mechanism only. See docs/design/phase2-plan.md §1.2.

origin.description: Provenance tag. Always 'user' for a verified selection.

lane.description: The single instrument lane this selection owns.

bar_start.description: First bar of the locked region (inclusive, 1-based).

bar_end.description: Last bar of the locked region (inclusive, 1-based). >= bar_start. Lock granularity is whole bars.

notes.description: Frozen closed-world ground truth: every corrected note for `lane` across bars bar_start..bar_end, each tagged with its bar (a within-bar position alone is ambiguous across a multi-bar region). Authoritative at compose time and the labels the param search reproduces.

ops.description: The edits that produced `notes`, kept for the change-log UI and anchor-replay-on-regen. Secondary to `notes`.

verified.description: True once the user has confirmed the region. Persisted selections are always true — `const: true` so the store cannot hold a selection that the compose path would silently skip. Unverified in-progress selections live in client state only.

base_fingerprint.description: Hash of the base notes in this lane x bar region at verify time, for region-drift detection on re-generation.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the selection was verified (server-set).

Lane.description: A staff lane the user can select and lock. `hihat` covers both hihat_closed and hihat_open (they share a lane; the open/closed distinction is a per-note property), so a verified hi-hat region owns every closed AND open hat in it. hihat_chick (foot close) is its own lane. Mirrors the frontend editor's lane vocabulary (edit.ts laneOf).

bar.description: 1-based bar this frozen note belongs to. Must fall within [bar_start, bar_end].

note.description: A full events-contract Note. Its instrument must belong to `lane` (lane_of(instrument) == lane).

Op.description: One anchored edit. Positions are exact rational strings (never rounded sixteenth indices) so triplet/tuplet edits stay representable. Reused by the system layer, whose ops carry origin='system'.

OpOrigin.description: Which layer authored this op. Omitted on user selection ops (implied user); set to 'system' on system-layer ops.
